candidates.statement: Order's postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the client connection pool reports size=5 and idle=0 across all sampled traces, so checkout requests block ~2s on pool acquisition and gateway returns 502. Pool exhaustion at the order->postgresql dependency is the bounded root cause.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side traces/metrics were excluded from context; pool saturation is inferred from gateway-observed spans only. No postgres server-side metrics confirm exhaustion versus slow queries.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout (~2s) trace to order's postgres save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0/size=5, while inventory/redis and payment calls succeed. Deployment record for order v1.0.0 does not establish causation. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion.
